gcrosshair89 provider/runtime validation
=======================================

Build mode:
  -std=c89 -pedantic -Wall -Wextra -Werror

Validated modules:
  gcrosshair_core89
    test_core: OK
    test_abi3_shapes: OK
    test_outline: OK

  gcrosshair_params89
    test_params: OK
    test_shapes: OK

  gcrosshair_base89
    test_base: OK (192 presets)
    test_recipe_loader: OK (192 INI presets)
    test_recipe_io_provider: OK

  gcrosshair_provider89
    vector provider accepts: OK
    vector provider declines -> internal core fallback: OK
    primitive provider/fallback routing: OK
    HUD viewport/anchor routing: OK
    asset provider routing: OK
    semantic preset metadata: OK
    bundled RGBA line/dot raster fallback: OK

  gcrosshair_runtime89
    preset -> style -> resolve -> provider route: OK
    bundled primitive plug-and-play path: OK
    semantic delegation of legacy stub preset: OK

Memory/numeric constraints:
  New provider89/runtime89 C/H contain no malloc/realloc/calloc/free,
  no float and no double. Caller-owned/static storage only.

Compatibility note:
  The original vector-only source itself contains 44 semantic vector stubs
  whose normal low-level ABI3 geometry emits zero primitives. They were not
  silently altered. Provider ABI 2 exposes preset semantic ID/name/category
  so an external vector/HUD provider can distinguish and implement them.
  See LEGACY_SEMANTIC_STUBS.md.
